prose: Basis: the page is a live routing dashboard that yields little static text, so this note rests on its visible description. There are now five inference providers serving the abliterated - refusal-trained-out - variant of DeepSeek, a fast reasoning model. The tracking page, AllModels, routes text requests across a fallback pool of providers and sends image requests only to providers that can actually handle them. The spread of abliterated hosting across five independent providers marks how quickly uncensored fine-tunes of frontier open models achieve mainstream inference distribution.
highlights: Five inference providers now serve the abliterated DeepSeek variant
Abliteration removes refusal behavior from the base model
The AllModels dashboard load-balances text routes and restricts image requests to capable providers
Uncensored fine-tunes of frontier open models now get mainstream inference distribution
